title: QIDI's CPU tuning script runs once a minute instead of every few seconds
note: qidi-tuning.service runs QIDI's tuning.sh (Type=simple, Restart=always, RestartSec=3). The script sets CPU affinity and priorities for Klipper, Moonraker, nginx, the camera and the screen program, pins the MCU serial and USB interrupts, and exits - so systemd started it again about every 3-5 seconds, forever, each run walking the process list (seen on the Max 4 by Valve-Oil: 8528 restarts in 3.5 days; the Q2 02.04 unit and script are the same). A drop-in sets RestartSec=60: the same settings, re-applied once a minute (e.g. after Klipper restarts). QIDI's files are not changed. Uninstall removes the drop-in.
